scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The proof generalizes two explicit analytic mechanisms in arXiv:2610.02032v1: the parity-amplitude identity and positive-definite Hermitian-part obstruction. A standalone finite verifier corroborates representative heterogeneous tuples but is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: Single-use product projective measurements with strictly positive local rotation angles whose total is \(\pi/2\); finite-round LOCC only. No optimal-error, noisy, infinite-round, or complete heterogeneous-angle classification claim.

title: Heterogeneous-angle strong nonlocality for product measurements
